## Jacobian and Keller maps

Polynomial Keller maps, their fibres, monodromy and boundary geometry.

**Authored assessment:** Explicit ordinary characteristic-zero Keller collisions give an internal failure of the unrestricted Jacobian conjecture under the retained proofs. ## Factorial moments and rigidity

Factorial moment functionals, composition rigidity and Strong Factorial families. One varying exponent also permits any independent common monomial factor, with all terminals covered.

**Authored assessment:** Ordinary univariate binomial Strong Factorial is proved at every terminal over every characteristic-zero field. The proof combines the terminal-through-24 theorem, the exact prime, Newton and modular certificate through terminal 3149, and the uniform Padé cutoff at terminal 3150. For arbitrary multivariate two-monomial supports, terminals 2 through 5 are proved. The result holds at all terminals for disjoint nonconstant monomials and when each monomial has private exponent sum at least two. The all-order multivariate and larger-support assertions remain open. Private exponent sums one and at least three are now covered at every terminal. For sums one and two, only terminals 6 through 360 with shared curvature below 4 log 2 remain in this class.

[Topic guide](factorial/README.md)

## Dixmier and Weyl algebras

Formal Weyl lifts, scalar mate obstructions, finite centralizers and exact quantum division spectra.

**Authored assessment:** All-order formal lifting, low-order DC1 automorphisms and scoped obstructions remain internally established. Canonical graded scalar Long lifts require spatial degree at least 28 with arbitrary parity; degree 27 is the sharp minimum through h5. The admitted XQ Airy source datum gives a matrix jet through h4 at degree 25, but its entire prescribed-first-coefficient family fails at h5 through degree 26. Three crossing coordinates give a one-order covariant correction test without a uniform bound. Actual polynomial Ore intertwiners obey strict mixed-corner descent in the stated rectangle, while the corrected primary DC1 comparison still leaves absolute subprincipal and global-admission constraints open. No bounded full Long lift or DC1/DC2 resolution is obtained.

## Meridional rank

Knot-group representations, branched-cover bounds and explicit sharp families.

**Authored assessment:** The prime four-bridge family has ar_C3<mr=bridge4, hyperbolic covers/exteriors, cycliccoverH1 and sharporbifoldtorsionrank4. Exact Fox identities exclude all scalar models and all models through the fixed A8 and A8 x C2 quotients, in every characteristic. Ordinary knot-group rank, other coefficientmodels, remaining known-family/priority boundaries and fullMRC stayopen. Every finite metabelian quotient of each Kn is generated by at most two elements. Verified symmetry proves exact ordinary rank3 for the32 named knot groups and for all closed double-cover groups of Kn, and bounds ordinary ranks of Gamma_n and G_n between3 and4. Disjoint protected blocks add root-plus-covector defects and give explicit knots with ar_C<=b-ceil(k/2); repeating the old alternating colors cannot certify gap2 by its support graph. A prime gap2 realization remains open.

## Formal verification

Formal developments and characteristic-zero Hopf/Image classifications: complete even-start purity via marked Davenport-Zannier pairs, Fuss-Catalan geometric counts and exact field descent; all-height safety and sharp degree/prime thresholds.

**Authored assessment:** Formal scope varies by project. GMC2 is conditional on two named axiom interfaces; binary GVC and full generic discriminant geometry remain partial.

[Topic guide](foundations/README.md)
